assumptions.text: Single-node baseline ceiling assumed; rates, message sizes and volumes are omitted by inputs.

entries.driver: Low rate, tiny payload, one ChatSession row per call, per PA-01
Long-lived stream, at most 5 tool calls, 30-second turn, per PA-01
Read-heavy, one ownership lookup plus one bounded page, per PA-01
One call per turn start, 12 messages plus summary, 16,000 tokens
One event per completed turn, at-least-once, summarizer call each, per PA-01
One event per turn, two appended entries, at-least-once, per PA-01
Up to 5 events per turn, one appended entry each, per PA-01
One keyset page per reload, ordered by turn and sequence, per PA-01

budgets.limit: At most 5 per turn, bound to configuration

measurement.assertion: Sixth tool call is refused; turn ends cleanly with limit notice
Turn timeout read from a bounded key; value equals 30 seconds

budgets.limit: At most 64 overall, 1 per session, per PA-01

measurement.assertion: Excess turn start answered 429; no waiter queued
Body above limit answered 413 before any model call

budgets.target: Session creation and message send admission
budgets.limit: At most 30 requests per user per window, per PA-01
At most 256 pending chunks, per PA-01

measurement.assertion: Slow consumer never exceeds 256 queued chunks; overflow ends stream
Pool maximum read from a bounded key; value equals 10

budgets.limit: 12 full messages plus summary, at most 16,000 tokens

measurement.assertion: Window holds at most 12 messages and 16,000 tokens

budgets.limit: At most 8 in flight, per PA-01

measurement.assertion: Ninth concurrent summarization waits in bounded buffer, never runs

budgets.limit: At most 3 attempts, idempotent by session and turn

measurement.assertion: Failing summarizer invoked exactly 3 times, then given up

budgets.target: Context window query wait for pending summary
budgets.limit: Bounded by remaining turn timeout, then last committed summary

measurement.assertion: Wait limit derived from the turn timeout key, no separate value

budgets.limit: At most 1,024 pending events, per PA-01

measurement.assertion: Buffer never exceeds 1,024; overflow rejected with counter
Pool maximum read from a bounded key; value equals 10

budgets.limit: At most 50 entries per page, keyset order

measurement.assertion: Page never returns more than 50 entries; larger request clamped

budgets.limit: At most 1,024 pending events, per PA-01

measurement.assertion: Buffer never exceeds 1,024; overflow rejected with counter

budgets.limit: At most 3 attempts, duplicate identity is no-op

measurement.assertion: Redelivered event adds zero rows; failing append tried 3 times
Pool maximum read from a bounded key; value equals 10

budgets.target: Queries per request on ownership-checked reads
budgets.limit: At most 2 store queries per reload request

measurement.assertion: Reload issues one ownership query and one page query

invariants.rule: No unbounded queue or buffer on any path
Saturation answered with rejection status, never silently absorbed
Redelivery and retries bounded; duplicate identity never adds rows
Streaming applies backpressure; event-loop threads never wait

duties.obligation: Count tool calls per turn; refuse beyond 5
Cap active turns; reject excess with 429
Reject oversized body with 413 up front
Limit requests per user; reject excess with 429
Bound stream buffer; apply backpressure to producers
Cap store connections for this context
Cap window at 12 messages and 16,000 tokens
Retry summary refresh at most 3 times
Bound window query wait by remaining turn timeout
Bound memory event buffer; reject overflow with counter
Cap store connections for this context
Clamp page size to 50 in keyset order
Bound history event buffer; reject overflow with counter
Retry appends at most 3 times; dedupe by identity
Cap store connections for this context
Reload uses at most 2 store queries

risks.risk: Overflowing event buffers may reject events, losing history entries
risks.residual: Rejected events counted; no replay source beyond redelivery

risks.risk: Message size, summary length and retention unspecified by inputs
risks.residual: Real traffic may need larger limits; history growth unbounded

risks.risk: External model latency cannot be bounded by the environment
risks.residual: Turns near ceiling hold concurrency slots until cancelled

risks.risk: Tool side effects persist when a turn is cut at a limit
risks.mitigation: accepted: limits stop further calls only
risks.residual: Completed tool effects are not undone
